description: This file implements the MediaKeys class and related factory functions for managing media key sessions, including creation, deletion, and querying of key sessions, with support for PlayReady DRM system. It also includes factory creation functions for IMediaKeys and IMediaKeysFactory, and logging for debugging and error handling.

classes.name: MediaKeys
classes.description: Implements media key session management, including creation, deletion, and querying of key sessions, with support for PlayReady DRM system.
